cookies.quote: to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles— the people living in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.”

cookies.instruction: Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.
cookies.reason: for the kingdom of heaven is near
I will make you fishers of men
